attributes.action: Appoint Ed Miliband as Chancellor in a Burnham Government
attributes.additional_details: We call for Ed Miliband to be appointed Chancellor in any future Andy Burnham government. Miliband has extensive government experience and has championed ambitious policies including public ownership of key utilities, investment-led growth, regional economic development, energy security and tackling inequality. His appointment would help ensure a Burnham government delivers meaningful economic reform and long-term national renewal.
attributes.background: Appoint Ed Miliband as Chancellor in any future Andy Burnham government. Miliband’s experience and ambitious economic vision on investment, public ownership, regional development and tackling inequality would help deliver a fairer, greener and more prosperous Britain.

rejection.details: We can't accept petitions that ask for someone to be given a job, or to lose their job.
